m.s: Rinse {quinoa} well in a sieve, as it stops it tasting bitter. Simmer in a saucepan with twice its volume of salted water for 12 minutes until the little tails pop out. Take it off the heat, cover and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork. Stir through chopped {parsley}, the zest of {lemon*0.5} and halved {cherrytom}.
Pat {whitefish} dry. Season generously with cracked black pepper, the rest of the lemon zest and salt.
Heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the fish for 2 to 3 minutes a side until opaque and it flakes easily. Set aside on a plate.
In the same pan, cook {broccoli} florets and trimmed {greenbeans} with a splash of water for 3 minutes until bright green.
Add crushed {garlic} and {spinach} and toss for 1 minute until the spinach wilts. Season with salt.
Squeeze the lemon juice over everything and serve the fish on the quinoa with the greens.

l: Fish over quinoa and greens. Best eaten within a day. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.
